description: This file defines a VGG backbone class and a function to create a RetinaNet model with a VGG backbone, including methods for downloading ImageNet weights and validating backbone options.

classes.name: VGGBackbone
classes.description: Class representing a VGG backbone with utility methods for model creation, weight downloading, validation, and image preprocessing.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Creates a RetinaNet model using the VGG backbone.

methods.name: download_imagenet
methods.description: Downloads ImageNet weights for the specified VGG backbone variant.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the backbone string is one of the allowed options ('vgg16', 'vgg19').

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Prepares an input image for processing by the network using 'caffe' mode.
